# Add two int32 slices in-place (dst += src).

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func AddInplace(dst, src []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += src[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func AddInplace(dst, src []int32) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(dst[_i:])
		_v2, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(src[_i:])
		_v1.Add(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := []int32{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
	src := []int32{10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80}
	test.AddInplace(dst, src)
	fmt.Println(dst)
}
-- testmain/output --
[11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func AddInplace(dst, src []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += src[i]
	}
}
